design: Structure comparison, fully crossed terrain and residual corrections, and four stage endpoints; no bottom explanatory text.

scientific_scope.design: Ten structures × two temperature inputs × two residual options; corrections retain all ten structures.
scientific_scope.terrain: Fixed lapse-rate correction precedes separate process recalibration; no claim of independently validated local temperature accuracy.
scientific_scope.residual: Schematic stage-specific residual model, not a neural-network architecture. Predictors include process dates, phase duration, weather, day length and terrain.
scientific_scope.target: Observed minus raw out-of-fold process date in calibration, with grouped nested refits.
scientific_scope.output: Correction adjusts attained dates; it does not repair non-attainment or modify process thermal states.
scientific_scope.validation: Grouped site holdouts within five represented environmental zones; not independent regional transfer.
scientific_scope.gains: No numerical gain or additive sequential-gain claim; corrections are evaluated as factorial contrasts.

verification.method: Matplotlib rendered text extents asserted within canvas and above footer exclusion zone.
